summary: Surveyed all 567 listed Lean files (about 9.2 MB) under Complexitylib/Models/RandomAccessMachine (205), Complexitylib/Models/TuringMachine (298), Complexitylib/Models/RoseTreeMachine (1) and Complexitylib/SAT (63); all are main-source-tree library modules, with no scripts, generated output, or vendored code. A line-start declaration grep (theorem/lemma/def/structure/class/instance/inductive/abbrev/example/axiom/opaque, with modifiers and attributes) found declarations in 561 files. The 6 zero-declaration files were read completely: each is a pure import aggregator (module header, public imports, doc comment), which FILTER-007 keeps primary-eligible because no verified auxiliary navigation channel is deployed. No file meets the FILTER-002/FILTER-004 bar, so the unit is retained in full.
